# Privacy policy

## GitHub Pages service

This website is hosted as a GitHub Pages website. GitHub may collect personal information from visitors to this GitHub Pages website, including logs of visitor IP addresses, to comply with legal obligations, to maintain the security and integrity of this website and the service, and to provide information and insight for future development of GitHub. See the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://help.github.com/en/github/site-policy/github-privacy-statement) for details.

## Data collection

We do not collect any data about visitors. However, [GitHub does so](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement#our-use-of-cookies-and-tracking-technologies).
